_template_notice: Sanitized DZP starter for .claude/settings.json. Copy this file to .claude/settings.json (which is gitignored) and adjust. The SessionEnd hook auto-refreshes the DZP Cortex index after each session (fail-soft, lock-guarded, 30s timeout). POSIX hosts: change the hook command to 'bash scripts/brain-index-hook.sh'. Remove the brain allow-entries you do not want.
